title: Fitbit Edge Battery Replacement Guide Released
excerpt: Google and iFixit provide a step-by-step guide for replacing the battery in the Fitbit Edge, though the process is challenging.
body_html:
Google has collaborated with iFixit to release a detailed, step-by-step guide focused on replacing the battery inside the Fitbit Edge device.

While the publication of the guide confirms that the battery is indeed replaceable, the process of swapping out the component is noted to be more difficult than expected.

The partnership provides users with official instructions for handling the repair, offering a resource for those looking to maintain their devices rather than replace them entirely.
